title: Cloud Security: incident specialists
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for incident specialists.

## Basis

Specialist assistance hourly rate: Approved incident-response professional assistance; USD per specialist-hour.

Included monthly specialist assistance hours: Included incident assistance per month; hours integer.

## Tier values

| Security tier | Specialist assistance hourly rate | Included monthly specialist assistance hours |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | 225 | 0 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | 225 | 0 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | 225 | 1 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | 225 | 2 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 1000 Workloads | 225 | 4 |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 2500 Workloads | 225 | 8 |

## Tier comparison

For included monthly specialist assistance hours, the 50 Workloads tier lists 0 and the 2500 Workloads tier lists 8.
